prompt:
Design the top of a square board-game box.

Title, exactly: "TIDEWATER" in a tall serif with a slight sea-worn texture, set in cream across the upper third. Beneath it, smaller, in the same cream: "A game of lighthouses and lost cargo".

Illustration: a night harbour seen from above at an angle, three lighthouses sweeping beams across dark water, small cargo ships leaving glowing wakes, a coastline of stone cottages. Painterly, rich navy and teal with warm amber light, fine detail in the ships.

Bottom-right corner, a small round cream badge with three lines: "2–4", "45 MIN", "AGE 10+". Bottom-left, a thin cream frame line with no other text. Square 1:1, print-ready feel, no publisher logo.
